Name: Interactive - Hands On Cooking (Cooking Minigame)
Author: wxunlimited
Description:
[center][color=#ffd966][size=6][b]Hands-On Cooking[/b][/size][/color]
[size=4][i]Stop clicking "Cook". Start cooking.[/i][/size]

[img width=320]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54905/54905-1793526631-1496337725.png[/img]

Click a recipe at your stove and a cozy pixel-art kitchen opens. Then you [b]actually cook it[/b]: knock the egg on the rim, slice along the dotted lines, whisk the batter, turn the knob, flick the pan to flip, slide the tray into the oven. Like [i]Cooking Mama[/i], but in Stardew Valley's own warm style.[/center]

[line]
[youtube]1ctvcBKWIis[/youtube]



[color=#ffd966][size=5][b]Every action is in your hands[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][b]Crack:[/b] tap the egg. Tap... tap... [i]CRACK![/i] Three knocks opens it. A fourth? It shatters into the bowl. Oops.[/*]
[*][b]Chop:[/b] the knife follows your hand; slice right on each dotted line. Pumpkins and yams take two chops.[/*]
[*][b]Whisk & stir:[/b] grab the whisk and stir circles until it's smooth. Too fast and it splashes everywhere.[/*]
[*][b]Fry:[/b] turn the brass knob into the green, wait for golden, then grab the pan and [i]flick it up[/i] to flip.[/*]
[*][b]Simmer:[/b] keep the pot bubbling gently, stir away the skin, and turn it down before it boils over.[/*]
[*][b]Bake:[/b] open the oven door, drag the tray in, set the dial, wait for the [i]ding[/i], drag it out.[/*]
[*][b]Knead, roll, pour, arrange & plate:[/b] push the dough, roll it to the circle (don't tear it!), pour to the line, and drag everything onto the plate.[/*]
[/list]
[b]All 81 vanilla recipes[/b] get their own steps across [b]34 cooking styles[/b]. Pancakes are measure → crack → whisk → pour → flip, flip → plate. Pizza is roll → chop → top → bake → slice.

[line]

[size=5][b]Your skill = your quality[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Perfect[/b] dishes become iridium-quality [color=#9b59d0][b]Hand-Crafted Meals[/b][/color]: +25% friendship as a gift.[/*]
[*]Great, Good and Okay give gold, silver and normal quality.[/*]
[*]Burn it, drop it, shatter it or boil it over and you get [i]Failed Cooking[/i]: a plate with a smoking black lump. Linus loves it. Nobody else does.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Grow as a cook[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Culinary skill[/b] (levels 1–10) with perks like [i]Second Wind[/i] (rescues one disaster per dish) and [i]Leftovers[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Professions:[/b] Prep Chef, Saucier, Cast Iron Master (pans never burn), Mise en Place, Hearty Meals, Village Favourite.[/*]
[*][b]Clint upgrades your kitchen:[/b] Copper, Steel, Gold and Iridium skillets, knives, pots, whisks, ovens and rolling pins.[/*]
[*][b]Better ingredients help:[/b] gold and iridium produce widen every sweet spot, and good eggs survive an extra knock.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]A kitchen that feels alive[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]A hand-drawn farmhouse kitchen: cast-iron range, a steaming kettle, jars on the shelf, the season outside the window.[/*]
[*]Steam, smoke, flames, flour puffs and sparkles. Stardew-style menus, fonts and quality stars.[/*]
[*][b]Special days:[/b] confetti on villagers' birthdays, hearts on your anniversary, petals, lanterns and snow for festivals, and bonus XP.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Play it your way[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Mouse[/b] on PC, [b]your finger[/b] on Android, or a [b]hand cursor[/b] on controller (left stick + A).[/*]
[*][b]Zoom in and out[/b] anytime: +/− buttons, mouse wheel, pinch or LB/RB.[/*]
[*][b]Quick Cook:[/b] hold Shift on a recipe to cook the old way. Perfect for big Luau prep.[/*]
[*][b]Assist mode[/b] for wider sweet spots and no disasters.[/*]
[*][b]Leave anytime[/b] with the X button: nothing is used up.[/*]
[*]In-game settings with Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Unzip into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[/list]Safe to add to an existing save. Remove any Failed Cooking before uninstalling.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 with SMAPI 4.0+ on Windows, Mac and Linux.[/*]
[*]Modded recipes work: they get cooking steps based on their ingredients.[/*]
[*]Other mods that replace the cooking menu (Love of Cooking, Better Crafting) may conflict; use one or the other for now.[/*]
[*]Android: touch controls are built in but not yet tested on a phone. Reports are very welcome![/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Hands-On Cooking — Quick-Start Guide[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]The basics[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Click a recipe at your stove. The kitchen opens and zooms in on the first station.[/*]
[*]A ghostly hand and the hint box show what to do.[/*]
[*]When the step is done well, a bouncing [b]Next[/b] button appears (bottom-right). Press it.[/*]
[*]After the last step, your dish lands on the plate with its grade.[/*]
[/list][b]Controls:[/b] mouse on PC, your finger on Android, or the hand cursor on controller (left stick moves, A grabs). Zoom with +/−, the mouse wheel, pinch or LB/RB. Press X (top-right), Esc or B to leave without using ingredients. Hold Shift on a recipe for vanilla Quick Cook.

[size=4][b]The 10 actions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Crack:[/b] tap the egg to knock it. 3 knocks = cracked, then Next. A 4th knock shatters it (gold/iridium eggs forgive one extra).[/*]
[*][b]Chop:[/b] tap right on each dotted line. Hard veg (gold line) needs a second chop.[/*]
[*][b]Whisk/stir:[/b] grab inside the bowl and stir steady circles until "Smooth!". Too fast splashes; 6 splashes ruins it.[/*]
[*][b]Fry:[/b] drag the knob into the green marks. At golden (sparkle), grab the pan and flick UP to flip. After the last flip, Next at golden. Flick straight up or the food flies out. Sautés: shake the handle side to side.[/*]
[*][b]Simmer:[/b] knob into the green; stir when a skin forms; turn DOWN if foam climbs.[/*]
[*][b]Bake:[/b] tap the door, drag the tray in, dial into the green, wait for the ding, open the door, drag the tray out.[/*]
[*][b]Knead:[/b] drag across the dough, one push per stroke, until "Smooth!".[/*]
[*][b]Roll:[/b] roll the pin over the dough until it fills the dotted circle. Stop at "Careful!"[/*]
[*][b]Pour:[/b] hold the sack/bottle, let go at the red line. Don't overflow.[/*]
[*][b]Arrange / Plate:[/b] drag pieces onto the dotted spots.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Grades[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Perfect (95+)[/b]: iridium Hand-Crafted Meal (+25% friendship as a gift)[/*]
[*][b]Great (80+)[/b]: gold · [b]Good (60+)[/b]: silver · [b]Okay (35+)[/b]: normal[/*]
[*][b]Burnt[/b] (under 35 or a disaster): Failed Cooking[/*]
[/list]Frying and baking count 3× and chopping, stirring, simmering and kneading 2×, so focus there.

[size=4][b]Progression[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Culinary XP[/b] = ingredients × 8 × grade bonus (Perfect ×2), +50 for each new recipe.[/*]
[*][b]Perks:[/b] Lv2 Steady Hands, Lv4 Second Wind, Lv6 Warm Hearth, Lv7 Leftovers, Lv8 Kitchen Companion, Lv9 Chef's Instinct.[/*]
[*][b]Professions:[/b] Lv5 Prep Chef or Saucier; Lv10 Cast Iron Master / Mise en Place, or Hearty Meals / Village Favourite.[/*]
[*][b]Clint's tools:[/b] Copper 1,000g · Steel 2,500g · Gold 5,000g · Iridium 12,500g, each plus 5 matching bars. Ready in 2 days. Best first buys: Skillet, then Oven.[/*]
[*][b]Special days:[/b] birthdays and anniversaries +25% XP, festivals (and the day before) +10%.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Your first three dishes[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Fried Egg:[/b] crack (3 knocks) → fry with one flip → plate. Get the heat green early and wait for the sparkle.[/*]
[*][b]Pancakes:[/b] measure → crack → whisk → pour → griddle with two flips → plate. The griddle carries the dish.[/*]
[*][b]Pizza:[/b] roll → chop → top → bake → slice. A great dish to practise after upgrading the knife and oven.[/*]
[/list][line]
